text:
raj: quick design review — compact inspector for tool-calling run history. attaching mock + notes. thinking: single-column compact view with collapsible schema preview, inline tool result badges, and small diff indicator for changed outputs. does this feel usable?

lina: love the single-column idea. main concern is discoverability of the schema — maybe show a 1-line summary + chevron to expand. 

sam: implementation note: expanding schema on every run could be expensive if we fetch full defs each time. suggestion: cache definitions client-side and fetch lazily. also we should avoid re-rendering the whole run list when someone toggles one preview.

lina: yeah cache + lazy fetch sounds right. visual thought: add a tiny "schema" pill with type icons (obj/arr/str) and a hover tooltip with quick sample output.

jordan-a11y: accessibility nits: keyboard focus needs to move into expanded schema. use roving tabindex pattern for the run items. when the schema expands, announce "Schema expanded for <tool-name>" via aria-live. color contrast on the diff chip is borderline — need >=4.5:1 for normal text.

carla: copy tweak: instead of "Expand schema" can we say "View response schema"? more explicit for PMs. also prefer "Re-run" over "Run again" in small buttons.

sam: noted for copy. about the small badges — do we want badges for cached vs fresh vs failure? that helps debugging in prod.

lina: yes badges: cached (gray), fresh (green), fallback (orange), error (red). keep them icon-only at 16px but with accessible aria-labels.

jordan-a11y: and tooltips need to be keyboard accessible (focusable). do not rely on :hover alone.

aria-bot: a11y-scan: compact-inspector-mock.png -> issues found: 2 contrast, missing aria-live for stream updates, non-focusable tooltip. See https://internal.a11y/reports/1962109876

raj: thanks — good catch. for streaming outputs: proposal is to include a small SR-only timestamped announcement like "new tokens streaming for <run-id>" while streaming starts, then "stream complete" when done. that should help screen readers.

sam: streaming SR announcements are fine but keep them debounced to avoid a flood if partial tokens arrive. maybe announce only on start and end.

lina: layout question: where does the run-level action menu live? inline at the right edge feels noisy on mobile. suggestion: collapse actions into a single kebab that opens a menu. on wide screens show text labels for the most common actions: Re-run, Copy JSON, Open in Inspector.

carla: product ask: add a tiny perf metric next to each run (latency ms). customers asked for quick cost signal too (tokens). keep it muted visually.

sam: I'll add perf and tokens to the run meta. for tokens we already have the value from the backend. note: avoid hitting APIs for extra metrics on the list render.

jordan-a11y: final: ensure each run item is a semantic list (<ul>/<li>) for screen readers, roles applied, and that the kebab menu is reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space to open).

lina: mock update plan: will make two variants — compact (single column) and compact-with-inline-schema (expanded by default for tool-only runs). will push PNG + figma link.

raj: awesome. timeline: can we get updated mock by EOD Friday? dev will estimate after Lina pushes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
